summary: Initial e2e test of Akron Digital site. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (root, contact POST stores with email_sent=false, invalid email 422, missing field 422, GET sorted desc, chat returns Claude reply mentioning Premium/$799, chat history persisted). Frontend: hero/headline, nav, portfolio (3 cards), packs (3 cards with $299/$799/$75 + Popular), calculator defaults (500/5%/$10,000 -> 25 clients / $250,000 CAD / $3,000,000 CAD) and updates via inputs+sliders, contact form empty-validation and successful submission, footer with phone/email/GTA/AKRON DIGITAL text, and chat widget end-to-end with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 response — all working. One real UX bug: pack-CTA pre-fill of contact dropdown doesn't work until full page reload (state syncing issue).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Get Premium' (or any pack CTA) sets sessionStorage 'akron_selected_pack' but the Contact form's useEffect only runs on initial mount (which already happened with empty value). Result: 'Interested In' dropdown stays empty unless the user reloads. Verified by setting sessionStorage=Premium after click, then reading select.value='' from the DOM.

The 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right partially overlaps the chat-toggle button (z-index/position). Clicks via Playwright force/JS still work, but a regular user mouse-click on the badge area instead opens emergent.sh. Consider raising chat-toggle z-index or offsetting it.

action_items: Fix Contact form pre-fill bug: Either lift selected-pack state up to App (so Contact gets it via prop), or attach a 'storage'/custom event listener in Contact's useEffect, OR have pack CTAs call a callback/setter directly. Easiest: dispatch a custom event from pack click and listen for it in Contact.
Optional: bump chat-toggle z-index above the Emergent badge or shift it left/up to avoid overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: chat endpoint creates a new LlmChat per request but emergentintegrations sessionizes via session_id, so prior turns inside LlmChat are not replayed from db.chat_messages — the comment 'Replay prior turns so the model has continuity' is misleading; in practice the LLM provider session keeps continuity. Acceptable for MVP.
App.js is a single 1250-line file. Recommend splitting into /src/components/{Header,Hero,Portfolio,Packs,Calculator,Contact,Footer,ChatWidget}.jsx for maintainability (>700 line rule).
Contact useEffect with [] deps reads sessionStorage once - root cause of pre-fill bug noted above.
Calculator allows visitors=0 / blank by setting onChange(0) on empty input — produces 0 results, fine but consider keeping last value or clamping to min.
No rate limiting on /api/contact or /api/chat — possible abuse vector in prod.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed contact records created in db.contacts plus a TEST_-prefixed chat session in db.chat_messages. Safe to leave or main agent can clear.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_akron_backend.py (run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_akron_backend.py -v). The only outstanding bug is the Contact form pre-fill from pack CTA — verify by clicking [data-testid='pack-cta-premium'] then reading [data-testid='contact-package-input'].value (should be 'Premium', currently '' until full reload).
rca_of_the_issue: Contact component reads sessionStorage('akron_selected_pack') inside a useEffect with empty dependency array. That effect runs ONCE when Contact mounts (at initial page load when sessionStorage is still empty). When the user later clicks Get Premium, sessionStorage is updated but the Contact component never re-runs that effect, so form.package state stays ''. The select renders value='' and shows 'Select a pack...'. Mitigation: (a) lift selected-pack into App-level state via Context and pass to Contact, (b) add 'storage' / custom event listener in Contact and dispatch event from pack click, or (c) make Contact re-check sessionStorage on hash change or scroll into view.
